race.comment: PERINI MISS (4) gets the nod after backing up a dominant Newcastle Maiden win with a sound third there, beaten a length and a half after being among the outsiders. That profile gives her the most convincing recent form, and she has already placed at the distance. COOL SUMMER NIGHTS (5) is the obvious danger after winning a Gosford Maiden in good style, with the wide passage adding merit to the performance and her 1600m record reading well. SHEEZA DIVA (1) has placed in both runs this campaign, including a third at Wyong after beginning slowly, and the weight relief helps offset the query of stretching back to 1600m. CANJUSTIFY (6) lightly raced staying type returning from a lengthy break. Showed potential last prep and comes here ready to go after the recent 1214m trial win at Warwick Farm. Blinkers come off and place claims look best.
